description: Payment Retry Loop Improvements - Enhance reliability and maintainability of installment payment retry system

userStories.title: Add payment retry state enum to database schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need explicit payment retry states so the system can track payment lifecycle clearly.
acceptanceCriteria: Add PaymentRetryState enum to schema: NEW | PROCESSING | RETRYING | SUCCEEDED | FAILED_PERMANENT
Add retryState field to PaymentRecord model (defaults to NEW)
Generate and run Prisma migration successfully
Typecheck passes with 'npm run typecheck'

userStories.title: Create payment retry state machine helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a state machine to manage payment state transitions safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/payments/payment-state-machine.ts with typed state transitions
Function validateTransition(fromState, toState) returns boolean
Function getNextState(currentState, result) returns new state
Function getAllowedTransitions(currentState) returns valid next states
Unit tests cover all state transitions
Tests pass with 'npm run test'
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Refactor chargeInstallment to use state machine
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the payment charging logic to use the state machine for consistency.
acceptanceCriteria: Update lib/payments/charge-installment.ts to import and use state machine
Replace manual status updates with state machine transitions
Update retryState field instead of just status field
Log state transitions for debugging
Existing tests still pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add payment retry metrics tracking
userStories.description: As a developer, I need metrics to understand retry patterns and optimize the system.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/payments/retry-metrics.ts module
Track: total retries attempted, success rate by attempt number, common failure reasons
Function recordRetryAttempt(paymentId, attemptNumber, result, errorCode)
Function getRetryMetrics() returns aggregated metrics
Metrics stored in database (create RetryMetrics table if needed)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add admin dashboard for retry monitoring
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to see payment retry status at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: Create app/admin/payments/retries/page.tsx
Display payments in RETRYING state with: booking reference, attempt count, next retry date, failure reason
Display retry metrics: total retries this week, success rate, most common failures
Add filter by retry state
Add manual retry button for admins
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser at /admin/payments/retries

userStories.title: Create AGENTS.md with payment retry patterns
userStories.description: As a developer, I need documentation of payment retry patterns for future work.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/payments/AGENTS.md
Document state machine pattern and valid transitions
Document retry policy: 3 days, 7 days, 14 days with exponential backoff
Document transient vs permanent error codes
Document idempotency key pattern
Document common pitfalls (double charging, infinite retries, etc.)
Include code examples for common operations
